description: Code quality tooling: enhance ESLint with jsx-a11y and import ordering plugins, add Prettier config, add husky + lint-staged config files, and add JSDoc annotations to key interfaces/contexts.
steps: Update eslint.config.js to add eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y (accessibility rules) and eslint-plugin-import (import ordering). Use flat config format. For import plugin, configure import/order rule to enforce groups: builtin, external, internal, parent, sibling, index. Set jsx-a11y to recommended.
Create .prettierrc.json with consistent formatting config: singleQuote: true, semi: true, tabWidth: 2, trailingComma: 'es5', printWidth: 100, jsxSingleQuote: false, bracketSpacing: true
Create .prettierignore with: dist, node_modules, coverage, stats.html
Add a 'format' script to package.json: prettier --write src/
Add a 'format:check' script to package.json: prettier --check src/
Create .husky/pre-commit file (just the config file content - do not run husky install or git hooks setup). Content should run npx lint-staged.
Add JSDoc annotations to src/context/AppContext.jsx - add @typedef for the context shape (key state and update function types) at the top of the file
Add JSDoc annotations to src/hooks/useWebVitals.js (the hook created in FEAT-002) - document params and return type

Run npm run lint to verify the new ESLint config works (fix any auto-fixable issues that arise from new rules, suppress non-critical issues that would require large refactoring with eslint-disable comments if necessary)
acceptance_criteria: eslint.config.js includes jsx-a11y and import plugins in flat config format
package.json has lint-staged config, format script, and format:check script
AppContext.jsx has JSDoc typedef for the context value shape
npm run lint passes (or only has warnings, no errors)
